claims.claim: At least 72 Sudanese workers were killed in an airstrike on a gold mine near the Egypt-Sudan border, and AFP reported the strike took place on Saturday.
claims.episode_span: An airstrike on Saturday killed at least 72 Sudanese workers at a gold mine near the Egypt-Sudan border
claims.source_title: Airstrike kills 72 Sudanese workers at Egypt-Sudan border gold mine
claims.supporting_quote: At least 72 Sudanese workers have been killed in an airstrike on a gold mine near the Egypt-Sudan border, a media report said on Monday.

claims.claim: Emergency Lawyers accused the Egyptian military, AFP said it could not independently verify the allegation, and Egypt had not issued an official comment.
claims.episode_span: Emergency Lawyers, which documents abuses in Sudan’s war, accused the Egyptian military
claims.source_title: Airstrike kills 72 Sudanese workers at Egypt-Sudan border gold mine
claims.supporting_quote: Emergency Lawyers, an organisation that documents human rights violations during Sudan’s war, accused the Egyptian military of carrying out the attack.

claims.claim: This was the second attack this year on an informal gold-mining site in Jabal al-Uqaydat, and a June attack killed 23 workers.
claims.episode_span: the second attack this year on an informal gold-mining site in Jabal al-Uqaydat
claims.source_title: Airstrike kills 72 Sudanese workers at Egypt-Sudan border gold mine
claims.supporting_quote: According to the report, this was the second attack this year on an informal gold-mining site in Jabal al-Uqaydat.

claims.claim: Egyptian technical teams are reportedly preparing the first army deployment to Somalia since a 2024 cooperation agreement, within bilateral cooperation and AUSSOM, and Egypt has not released the contingent size.
claims.episode_span: preparing the first deployment of Egyptian army troops to Somalia since a joint military cooperation agreement in 2024
claims.source_title: As tensions soar in the African horn, Egypt prepares to deploy troops to Somalia
claims.supporting_quote: Technical military teams from Egypt, including advisors, trainers and officers, are reportedly busy preparing for the deployment of army troops to Somalia, the first such move in the Horn of Africa nation, since the signing of a joint military cooperation agreement between the two sides in 2024.

claims.claim: Egyptian troops are reportedly to be positioned at Ceelcade, about 400 kilometres from the nearest point of Ethiopia’s border with Somalia, and a delegation met Defence Minister Ahmed Moallim Fiqi on 20 September.
claims.episode_span: headed for Ceelcade, site of the former Cisiley Airfield
claims.source_title: As tensions soar in the African horn, Egypt prepares to deploy troops to Somalia
claims.supporting_quote: The Egyptian troops will reportedly be positioned in the Ceelcade region which used to house the Cisiley Airfield on the immediate northern outskirts of Mogadishu, within the Middle Shabelle region—in the low-lying semi-arid coastal hinterland just north of the Banaadir administrative boundary, around 400 kilometres from the nearest point to Ethiopia's shared border with Somalia.

claims.claim: Kenya’s Cabinet approved $350 million in shareholder financing for Kenya Airways on 9 October, with instalments, Treasury oversight, repayment of up to 10 years, and possible later conversion to equity.
claims.episode_span: On 9 October the Cabinet approved $350 million in shareholder financing for Kenya Airways
claims.source_title: Kenya approves $350 million rescue to get grounded planes flying as national airline faces $941 million debt overhaul
claims.supporting_quote: The Cabinet approved the shareholder financing on 9 October as Kenya Airways works to restore aircraft capacity, meet urgent financial obligations and attract investors.

claims.claim: A separate proposal would restructure about $941 million in existing government loans into an equity-qualifying instrument and would not provide another $941 million in cash.
claims.episode_span: convert about $941 million in existing government loans into an equity-qualifying tradable instrument
claims.source_title: Kenya approves $350 million rescue to get grounded planes flying as national airline faces $941 million debt overhaul
claims.supporting_quote: That proposal concerns debt already owed by the airline and would not provide another $941 million in cash.

claims.claim: Kenya Airways reported a first-half 2026 pre-tax loss of about $123 million, and fuel costs rose 72 percent, accounting for as much as half of total costs.
claims.episode_span: a first-half 2026 pre-tax loss of about $123 million
claims.source_title: Kenya approves $350 million rescue to get grounded planes flying as national airline faces $941 million debt overhaul
claims.supporting_quote: Kenya Airways reported a first-half pre-tax loss of approximately $123 million in 2026.

claims.claim: One person was killed and 11 injured in another attack on King Khalid International Airport, a day after a Houthi-claimed strike killed 13 and injured more than 300, and the airport was to remain closed another 24 hours.
claims.episode_span: One person was killed and 11 injured in another attack on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport

claims.supporting_quote: In today’s episode of Trending Middle East , one person is killed and 11 injured in another attack on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport – a day after 13 were killed and more than 300 injured in a strike claimed by the Houthi rebels.
